_comment: WHALEHUNTERHEDGE v1.0 LONG sleeve — patient-whale conviction copy. Watches traders tagged ELITE (consistency) AND PATIENT (activity) on Senpi Discover and mirrors their high-conviction LONG strikes: a NEW position whose marginUsed/accountValue (capital at risk as a share of THEIR balance) clears convictionPct. Sized to MY budget, conviction- and consensus-scaled; leverage capped (conviction shows in size, not leverage). Pairs with the short sleeve on a SEPARATE wallet so the book can hold conflicting positions on one asset at once (whale A long ETH + whale B short ETH => both held). Wide ride-the-whale DSL via runtime-long.yaml. Requires a USER-scoped SENPI_AUTH_TOKEN (discovery_* needs a user id). Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Producer launched with WHALEHUNTER_LEG=long.
_pool_note: consistencyTags + activityTags are the gate. ELITE+PATIENT is intentionally STRICT (a small, pristine pool of consistent winners who rarely trade). If it's too thin to ever fire, widen activityTags to ["PATIENT","TACTICAL"] — a one-line change, no rebuild. poolMinTraderAgeDays buffers survivorship.
_conviction_note: convictionPct = the whale's marginUsed / accountValue on the NEW position — capital at risk as a share of THEIR balance (the truest read of conviction; not leverage-inflated notional). 0.25 = they put >=25% of their book in. Raise for an even sharper sniper; lower for more signals.
_sizing_note: MY margin = account_value * marginPct, scaled up by their conviction and by pool consensus (more whales agreeing), capped at maxMarginPct of equity. Leverage is stdLeverage capped at maxLeverage then the venue max — conviction shows in SIZE, never inherited leverage. Nothing here is a hardcoded $ amount. Funding split across the two sleeves: default 50/50 (balanced long/short, no directional bias).
_persona: Patient-whale conviction sniper — LONG sleeve. Shadows ELITE+PATIENT winners and strikes only their rare, big-conviction LONG bets, then rides on a wide DSL. One of two sleeves of WhaleHunterHedge; pairs with the opposite sleeve on a separate wallet so conflicting same-asset positions can coexist.
